title.en: Facilitating the Merger or Consolidation of Public Utilities in Telecommunications

text.en:
For the purpose of facilitating mergers or consolidations of public utilities engaged in the
operation of telecommunications facilities, any such public utility corporation may merge or consolidate with
another such public utility corporation, and the capital stocks of such corporations may be increased to the
extent necessary to effect such merger or consolidation by the affirmative vote of the stockholders
representing at least a majority of the subscribed capital stock in a stockholders' meeting called for that
purpose, notwithstanding provisions of existing laws to the contrary.

The proceeds from the sale of stocks and/or the consolidation of assets, resulting from any
corporate merger of consolidation, upon the approval of the President, shall be free from all taxes on capital
gains and income tax, notwithstanding provisions of existing laws to the contrary.

This Decree shall take effect immediately and shall remain in force for a period of five (5) years
from date hereof.
Done in the City of Manila, this 1st day of January, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and eighty-one.
